FEEDING ADI — EP. 01 ✨♥️ 
Normal food. Better macros.

Chicken Steak in Creamy Mushroom Sauce
Adi wanted steak with mushroom sauce.
I wanted something that fit our goals.
So I made it my way.🥰 

323 kcal | 42g P | 17g C | 9g F
Serves 3

INGREDIENTS

Chicken Steak
* 450g chicken breast, flatten each breast for easy cooking
* 1 tsp garlic powder
* 1 tsp onion powder
* 1 tsp paprika
* ½ tsp dried parsley
* Salt & black pepper

Creamy Mushroom Sauce
* 200g button mushrooms, sliced
* 100g cremini mushrooms, sliced - not necessary can use normal button also 
* 1 onion, finely chopped
* 1 tsp olive oil
* 1 tsp Dijon mustard
* 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce
* 1 tsp soy sauce
* ½ tsp garlic powder
* ½ tsp onion powder
* 200 - 250ml water
* 120g Greek yogurt - room temp - take it out 30 minutes before you start cooking 
* 1 tbsp cornflour
* 2 tbsp water
* Salt & black pepper

METHOD
Season the chicken with garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, dried parsley, salt and pepper.
Sear the chicken in a hot pan until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add olive oil and sauté the onion. Add the button and cremini mushrooms and cook until softened and golden.
Add Dijon mustard, Worcestershire sauce, soy sauce, garlic powder and onion powder. Mix well.
Add the water and bring to a simmer. Mix the cornflour with 2 tbsp water and stir into the sauce. Cook until slightly thickened.
Lower the heat. Mix a little of the warm sauce into the Greek yogurt first, then add it back into the pan and stir until creamy.
Plate the chicken and spoon the mushroom sauce generously over the top.
PRO TIP: Temper your Greek yogurt before adding it to the sauce so it stays smooth and creamy instead of splitting - temper is basically add a few tbsp of sauce to the yogurt.

Save this for the next time you want steak night without feeling like you’re eating diet food. 🤍
